newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Novadigm cut to neutral.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Novadigm cut to neutral.

text.p: -- Alex. Brown said it lowered its recommendation on Novadigm Inc to neutral from buy.
-- Analyst Chris Mortenson was not immediately available to comment.
-- The company said Friday that revenue for the 1997 fiscal third quarter ended December 31 wil lbe significantly below expectations and a net loss is expected to be greater than forecast.
-- Shares fell 2-5/16 to 6-11/6, or almost 26 percent, in morning Nasdaq trade.
